fusions.name: Final Verse
fusions.desc: Sings the target down, dealing 18 damage and consuming every affliction on it, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 20% health.

fusions.name: Practised Cadence
fusions.desc: Looses 3 notes at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Choral Drill
fusions.desc: Every ally within 5 tiles strikes 15% harder for 10 seconds, and fights with 1 more power while it holds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Phrase
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your next spell deals 25% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
